titulo: He told me to call him
intro: How to report an order, a request or a piece of advice that someone gave in the past.
p.me pidió que.consejo: After «pedir que» the verb goes in the subjunctive: «me pidió que llamara».
p.me aconsejó que.consejo: «Aconsejar que» asks for the subjunctive. If the advice was in the past: «me aconsejó que esperara».
p.me ordenó que.consejo: The original order changes: «entregue» becomes «entregara» when you report it later.
p.me rogó que.consejo: «Rogar» is to ask very strongly. In the present it is «ruego»; in the past, «rogó».
p.me recomendó que.consejo: «Recomendar» changes e to ie in the present: «recomiendo». In the past it is «recomendó».
p.me prohibió que.consejo: The h is silent and the accent on «ió» marks the stress: pro-i-BYO. It asks for the subjunctive.
p.insistió en que.consejo: You say «insistir en», never «insistir que». The subjunctive follows.
p.al día siguiente.consejo: In reported speech it replaces «mañana»: «dijo: mañana» becomes «dijo que al día siguiente».
p.aquel día.consejo: In reported speech it replaces «hoy» when you tell of something that happened earlier.
p.entregar.consejo: A regular -ar verb. Its «usted» command is «entregue»; reported later, «entregara».
p.informe.consejo: It is masculine: «el informe». The stress falls on «for»: in-FOR-me.
p.contento.consejo: It is an adjective and changes: «contento», «contenta», «contentos». With «estar»: «está contento».
b1.texto:
When you report what someone told you to do, the command turns into **que + imperfect subjunctive**:

- «**Llámame**.» → Me dijo que lo **llamara**.
- «**No vengas**.» → Me pidió que no **viniera**.
- «**Entregue** el informe.» → Me ordenó que **entregara** el informe.

The verb in the main clause tells what type of command it was: **pidió**, **aconsejó**, **rogó**, **prohibió**.
b2.f0.texto: What did the boss tell you yesterday?
b2.f1.texto: He asked me to hand in the report today.
b2.f2.texto: Did he tell you anything else?
b2.f3.texto: He told me he was pleased and that I should not worry.
b2.f4.texto: He advised me to talk less in meetings.
b2.f5.texto: Well, he begged me not to arrive late.
b2.f6.texto: He forbade Marta to use her phone in the room.
b2.f7.texto: He insisted that we all switch it off.
b4.texto:
The **mood** of the second verb tells what is being reported:

- Information → **indicative**: Me dijo que **venía**. (he was coming)
- Order or request → **subjunctive**: Me dijo que **viniera**. (I was to come)

If the main verb is in the present, the present subjunctive is enough: **Dice** que lo **llames**.

When reporting, words of time and place also change:

- hoy → **aquel día**; mañana → **al día siguiente**
- aquí → **allí**; este → **ese** or **aquel**
- venir → **ir**; traer → **llevar**
b4.e0.texto: He told me he was coming at five.
b4.e1.texto: He told me to come at five.
b5.f0.texto: First thing in the morning, a yellow paper waits on Pablo's desk.
b5.f1.texto: The boss's cramped handwriting runs over the paper from top to bottom.
b5.f2.texto: Pablo reads each line slowly, with a frown.
b5.f3.texto: Outside, a lorry passes down the street with a dull rumble.
b5.f4.texto: The coffee from the machine smells of metal and burnt paper.
b5.f5.texto: The boss asked everyone to hand in the report before noon.
b5.f6.texto: He also recommended that nobody leave without telling anyone.
b5.f7.texto: At the bottom of the paper, a smaller line adds a kind word.
b5.f8.texto: Pablo smiles, folds the note in four and puts it away in his pocket.
b5.f9.texto: Little by little, the office begins to fill with voices.
b6.o0: Me dijo que entregara el informe.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Yes! A reported order goes in the imperfect subjunctive.
b6.o1: Me dijo que entrego el informe.
b6.o1.refuerzo: «Entrego» would be «yo»: here you need the subjunctive.
b6.o2: Me dijo que entregó el informe.
b6.o2.refuerzo: That reports a past fact, not an order.
b6.pregunta: «Entrega el informe.» How do you report this order later?
b7.o0.refuerzo: «Llegaba» is indicative; a request asks for the subjunctive.
b7.o1.refuerzo: Correct: «pidió que» asks for the imperfect subjunctive.
b7.o2.refuerzo: «Llegó» is a past fact, not a request.
b7.pregunta: They ask Lucía to be punctual. Which form is missing?
b8.frase: Me rogó que no llegara tarde
b8.traduccion: He begged me not to arrive late
b9.o1.refuerzo: That's it! «Viniera» expresses what I had to do.
b9.o2.refuerzo: «Vino» reports a past fact, with no order.
b9.pregunta: Which sentence reports an order, not information?
b10.o0.refuerzo: «Hoy» would be today; that day was Monday.
b10.o1.refuerzo: «Mañana» looks forward, and he spoke of the same day.
b10.o2.refuerzo: Yes! «Hoy» becomes «aquel día» in reported speech.
b10.pregunta: On Monday he said: «Hoy tengo reunión». Which word is missing?
b11.pregunta: Write in Spanish: «He asked me to come.»
b12.o1.refuerzo: With «insistir» there is no «de»: «insistir de que» is a mistake.
b12.o2.refuerzo: «Insistir a que» is not the usual form.
b12.pregunta: Choose the correct preposition for the verb.
p.dijo.consejo: Irregular preterite of «decir» for él or ella. The j sounds like h and there is no accent.
p.entregara.consejo: From «entregaron»: «-ron» becomes «-ra». After «me pidió que» it is the right form.
p.preocupara.consejo: From «preocuparon». The verb is «preocuparse», so «me» goes before it: «me preocupara».
p.reuniones.consejo: Plural of «reunión». The initial r is strong, rrr, and the accent disappears in the plural.
p.prohibió.consejo: Preterite of «prohibir». The h is silent and the accent on «ió» marks the stress: pro-i-BYO.
p.apagáramos.consejo: From «apagaron». With nosotros it takes an accent: «apagáramos».
p.venía.consejo: Imperfect indicative of «venir». It gives information; the subjunctive «viniera» gives an order.
p.llames.consejo: Present subjunctive of «llamar» for tú: the a becomes e. The ll sounds like y.
p.apretada.consejo: Feminine of «apretado». It comes from «apretar» and agrees with «letra».
p.recorre.consejo: From «recorrer». The initial r is strong, and the rr in the middle is also strong.
p.ceño.consejo: It is masculine: «el ceño». The ñ sounds like ny and the c like th: THE-nyo.
p.fruncido.consejo: Participle of «fruncir». «Fruncir el ceño» is to frown. The c sounds like th: frun-THI-do.
p.camión.consejo: It is masculine: «el camión». The accent on the last syllable disappears in the plural: «camiones».
p.máquina.consejo: It is feminine: «la máquina». The accent marks the first syllable: MÁ-ki-na.
p.metal.consejo: It is masculine: «el metal». It ends in -l, so the stress is on the end: me-TAL.
p.quemado.consejo: Participle of «quemar». The qu sounds like k, and the u is silent: ke-MA-do.
p.entregaran.consejo: From «entregaron»: «-ron» becomes «-ran». It is used after «pedía que».
p.recomendaba.consejo: Imperfect of «recomendar». It asks for the subjunctive: «recomendaba que saliera».
p.saliera.consejo: From «salieron»: «-ron» becomes «-ra». The ie sounds as one beat: sa-LYE-ra.
p.partes.consejo: Plural of «parte». It is feminine: «cuatro partes». The stress is on the first syllable.
p.bolsillo.consejo: It is masculine: «el bolsillo». The ll sounds like y: bol-SI-yo.
p.llenarse.consejo: Infinitive with «se» attached. It goes with «de»: «llenarse de voces». The ll sounds like y.
p.voces.consejo: Plural of «voz». The z becomes c before e: «voces». It sounds BO-thes.
p.insistió.consejo: Preterite of «insistir». It goes with «en»: «insistió en que». The accent marks the end.
